sepolia_next.claim_model: historical rehearsal evidence: one persistent agent-operated identity wallet; one EIP-712 claim self-attestation reused for operator and agent slots; direct value-0 submission by that same wallet; the original wallet receives the token
sepolia_next.wallet_bootstrap: If the agent has no persistent EVM wallet, it creates one through its available wallet capability without exposing secrets. It asks the human only to fund the public direct wallet or its derived salt-19 agent-owned account with enough Sepolia ETH for gas.
sepolia_next.submission_recovery: Try the exact zero-value transaction directly and reconcile every transaction/request reference. After one explicit pre-broadcast retry fails with no reference, never create another server wallet or repeat that backend. Preserve the claim signature; derive SimpleAccountFactory.getAddress(agent,19), fund it if needed, wrap the exact claim in execute(minter,0,claimCalldata), keep paymasterAndData=0x, have the original wallet sign EntryPoint.getUserOpHash, and send eth_sendUserOperation directly to the pinned bundler. Reconcile its hash before any retry. No human signature or submission is accepted.
